name: Everwake serum
body:
Source Champions of Corruption pg. 27
Price 2,500 gp; Weight —
Type ingested; Save Fortitude DC 16
Frequency 1/day for 5 days
Effect cannot voluntarily rest or sleep (spells such as sleep still function as normal), preventing spellcasters who need to rest to regain or prepare spells from doing so
Cure 2 saves
